metadata.title: Urban Portraiture with High-Contrast Jewelry and Tattoos

retrievalProfile.description: A tight, symmetrical headshot of a man with intricate face tattoos and heavy diamond jewelry set against a vibrant, textured red backdrop.
triggerTerms: intense blue eyes portrait red background

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up portrait of a man with light blue eyes and extensive facial and body tattoos. He holds his hands to his ears, framing his face, while wearing multiple diamond-encrusted bracelets and a heavy silver chain. The lighting is soft but directional, highlighting the texture of the skin and the sparkle of the jewelry against a deep red, slightly vignetted background.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the hands framing the face and the central vertical axis of the nose and chin.
High contrast between the cool blue of the eyes and the warm, saturated red of the background.
Texture interplay between the matte skin/ink and the reflective, crystalline surface of the jewelry.
coreInvariants: Intense, direct eye contact with the viewer.
Vibrant, saturated red background with subtle texture.
Heavy, iced-out jewelry including bracelets and a thick chain.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, subject occupies 80% of the frame, centered vertically and horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's light blue eyes serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the blue eyes, moves outward to the framing hands, down to the heavy chain, and back up through the facial tattoos.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, confined to the upper corners and sides in a deep red hue.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep crimson red background providing warmth and intensity.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright, icy blue eyes providing a sharp focal point.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver and white from the diamond jewelry adding highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with mid-tone skin values and high-value specular highlights on the jewelry.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail close-up portrait of a man with face tattoos and blue eyes, hands to ears, wearing diamond jewelry against a textured red studio backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, modern sans-serif or a stylized blackletter font in white or silver, positioned at the bottom third to avoid obscuring the face.

verificationChecks: Ensure the eyes are a piercing blue.
Check that the jewelry has realistic specular highlights.
Verify the red background has a subtle vignette and texture.

mustRedesign: Avoid generic or flat lighting that loses the sparkle of the diamonds.
Ensure tattoos look integrated into the skin texture, not like stickers.

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and jewelry.

postGenerationChecks: Are the eyes the sharpest point of the image?
Does the jewelry appear three-dimensional and reflective?
Is the red background vibrant without being distracting?
Is the symmetry maintained in the pose?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered, symmetrical portrait pose with high-contrast color theory (complementary blue/red) and high-detail textures (ink/diamonds) to create an impactful urban editorial image.
